lines.en: I tread the red earth step by step.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾抠进干裂的泥
lines.en: My toes dig into the cracked clay.
I work my way down the gully.
I cross a cracked riverbed.
I sweep the ground with lowered head.
I drag my tail through the rubble.
I move sideways up the badland slope.
A crumb of weathered earth gives way.
I push forward in short strides.
I turn along the dry channel.
I stop and shake my neck.
I start up the slope again.

lines.zh: 我的影子在红岩上拖长
lines.en: My shadow stretches over red rock.
I keep heading for that pillar.
I pant in the shade.
I hold my jaws open to cool.
I stand in the middle of the badlands.
I wait in the rock's shadow for it to cool.
I rest my jaw on the ridge.
I do not even lift an eyelid.
I wait for the sun to lean west.
I curl my tail slowly in.
I raise my eyes to the stone forest.
A sound rolls in my throat.
My back rises and falls.
I close my jaws again.
I sniff the local soil.
My feet sink in the loose earth.
I raise my head from behind the ridge.
I fix one eye on you.
You're standing still. I understand.
I shift half a foot forward.

lines.zh: 恶地的风把我的吼声带走。
lines.en: The badlands wind carries my growl away.
You are standing on my ground.
I twist my neck toward you.
I watch your shadow instead of you.
I open my jaws a crack.
You reek of sweat.
I tip my head your way.

lines.zh: 我想先看看你敢不敢动
lines.en: Let me see if you dare move.
I rock and brace myself.
I growl and give a step.
A strip of my hide is scraped open.
I shake my heavy head.
I crush a lump of earth.
I settle my weight low again.
I gape and gulp for air.
My four legs still hold.
The horn on my snout scraped open.
I do not mean to turn tail.
You raise that little thing high.
I lean in and sniff.
That meat would not fill a tooth.
This thing goes in one bite.
I lick along my lower jaw.
I raise my head at you again.
I flick it aside with a foot.
The smell is too faint.
I shake my head and go.
I would rather hunt for myself.
You ram me and I do not give an inch.
I turn my flank and crowd you off.
My hide is thick as stone.
My tail sweeps you aside.
We knock with a muffled crack.
My tail throws up a layer of dust.
I look down where we struck.
That force is nothing.
I shove forward an inch.
I plant my feet again.

lines.zh: 另一头从土坎后转出来
lines.en: Another comes round the ridge.
We meet nose to nose.
Its neck is thicker than mine.
We walk down the gully abreast.
It nudges me with its snout.

lines.zh: 我们一同停在一根石柱旁
lines.en: We stop together by a pillar.
A low note rolls from its throat.
We make no further sound.
It heads up the slope first.
I step in its tracks.
I dip my head and take a piece.
Blood on red sand—you can't tell.
I gulp it down.
It lodges in my throat.
I cough twice.
I pin the meat down with a foreclaw.
One sniff and I drop it.
I scrape it aside.
I do not lower my head again.
I stride off toward the pillar.
My head stops dead.
I turn my flank to that shadow.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在土里抓了抓
lines.en: My toes scrabble in the dirt.
I load my weight on the front feet.
I give one roar first.
I have seen where you are.
The slope favours me.
I have counted these three strides.
I bring my head level with my shoulders.
I do not mean to wait longer.
I lean half my body forward.
My shadow bears down on you.
That foot is already lifted.
I am ready to charge.
I close in with heavy steps.

lines.zh: 你往石柱后躲，我绕过去
lines.en: You duck behind a pillar; I go round.
I herd you into the open.
I growl and come on step by step.

lines.zh: 你退一步我就补上一步
lines.en: Each step you give, I take.
I wait for your foot to slip.
This red earth is soft and poor for running.
I lower my head to the ground.
You have raised a hand.
I cut in from the left.
I hear you gasping.
Three strides cover this distance.
I halt, then come on again.
You have backed to the pillar.
I mean to hit with my head.
My shoulder dips forward.
It will likely move first.
My skull comes down like a hammer.
My teeth sink into its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我用侧身把它的腿铲倒
lines.en: My flank sweeps its legs out.
It slides a good way.
I plant a foot on its back.
I wrench my head and tear its hide.
It twists and wrenches free.
I butt it again from the flank.
I slam it into the pillar.
It bites my forelimb.
I shake its teeth loose.
We kick red dust into the air.
It backs off; I do not chase far.
I stand and pant.
It pushes itself up.

lines.zh: 我把头低的更低，等它再来
lines.en: I lower my head and wait for more.
I step out from behind the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的脚在红土上印出深坑
lines.en: My feet press deep prints in the red.
I sniff the hot wind first.
I take my stand by a broken pillar.
My tail sweeps the gravel.
The badlands gain one more.
I stretch my neck to look.

lines.zh: 我从恶地的沟壑里爬出。
lines.en: I climb out of a badlands ravine.
I have found this sunning ground.
I begin patrolling the gully.
The earth here is red.
Red sand slides off my back.
My shadow falls on the rock wall.
I lower my head and climb the slope.
I catch a loose stone underfoot.
I will wait here for the sun.
Fire scorches my back.
I roll down the gully.
Water fills the dry bed.
The blast tips me onto my side.

lines.zh: 有硬东西嵌进我肩头的皮
lines.en: Something hard lodges in my shoulder.
Spell light makes me toss my head.
Hunger hollows my hind legs.
Lightning splits the nearby pillar.
The whole red floor is gone.
